answer: Concretely, the economy can chain each registration to a per-identity nonce derived from the prior epoch hash so clones collide. A single reused nonce reveals every sibling at once. Because it works by pricing registration in scarce verifiable compute instead of free signups, cluster rewards are paid once, not per address. The atlas of work and the shale of evidence must both recur for the same identity, and a zephyr to an external peer is the only path that releases the bond.
